departments.title: Departments
departments.intro: Group your pipelines by team so they're easier to find, filter and report on. Departments are optional. A pipeline without one is filed under No department.
departments.builtIn: Built in. It can't be renamed or deleted.
departments.howBody: Pick a department when you create a pipeline, or leave it as No department. Recruiters and hiring managers only see pipelines in the departments you give them access to in {link}. Pipelines in No department are visible to admins only. Deleting a department never deletes its pipelines or candidates.
